pipelineA_DeterministicWithVerifiedCache.description: Deterministic branch parsing, local verified coordinate cache, zero LLM calls

pipelineB_SelectiveLlmWithExternalGeocod.description: Deterministic parsing + selective unified LLM validation on low-confidence cases + Geocoding API

costLatencyAnalysis.rationale: Pipeline A delivers 100% pin precision with sub-millisecond latency (0.18 ms) and zero API expense. Pipeline B is triggered strictly when an offer has low confidence or unverified high-value branches.
